A uniform wire is suspended from a fixed support. Masses are added to the other end of the wire, as shown in Fig. 6.1.

{{figure:9702_s23_23_q06_figure_6_1}}

Fig. 6.1 (not to scale)

The variation of the length $l$ of the wire with the force $F$ applied to the wire by the masses is shown in Fig. 6.2.

{{figure:9702_s23_23_q06_figure_6_2}}

The cross-sectional area of the wire is $0.95\text{ mm}^2$.
parts.text: Determine the unstretched length of the wire.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
For an applied force $F$ of $30\text{ N}$, determine:

• the stress in the wire

• the strain of the wire.
